data.reasoning: The package is a standard VCS (git) package for a Rust application. The PKGBUILD contains no malicious top-level code, no suspicious network requests, and uses standard build and install routines. The .SRCINFO is a standard auto-generated metadata file, and .gitignore is benign. There are no injection risks.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool failure rather than a difference in security analysis. The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to audit the .SRCINFO file, forcing an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Improve error handling for transient LLM API errors so that a failure to audit a single non-executable metadata file (like .SRCINFO) does not force an 'inconclusive' verdict for the entire package when the core executable files (PKGBUILD) are successfully audited and deemed safe.
